arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  ac.concept_code AS atc_code,
  ac.concept_name AS antidepressant_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT de.drug_exposure_id) AS exposure_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.person p
  ON p.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept ac
  ON ac.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
WHERE ac.vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
  AND ac.concept_class_id = 'ATC 4th'
  AND ac.concept_code LIKE 'N06A%'
  AND (
    YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) - p.year_of_birth
    - CASE
        WHEN p.month_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND p.day_of_birth IS NOT NULL
             AND (MONTH(de.drug_exposure_start_date) < p.month_of_birth
                  OR (MONTH(de.drug_exposure_start_date) = p.month_of_birth
                      AND DAY(de.drug_exposure_start_date) < p.day_of_birth))
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
  ) >= 65
GROUP BY ac.concept_code, ac.concept_name
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, exposure_count DESC;

In adults aged ≥65 at antidepressant exposure, the most common ATC antidepressant classes were:

| Rank | ATC class | Patient count | Exposure count |
|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | Other antidepressants (`N06AX`) | 42,514 | 686,000 |
| 2 | SSRIs / Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (`N06AB`) | 28,820 | 409,463 |
| 3 | Non-selective monoamine reuptake inhibitors / TCAs (`N06AA`) | 7,992 | 62,036 |
| 4 | Non-selective MAO inhibitors (`N06AF`) | 34 | 454 |

Method: OMOP `drug_exposure` joined to `person`, counted exposures where age at `drug_exposure_start_date` was ≥65, mapped drugs to ATC 4th-level `N06A%` antidepressant classes via `concept_ancestor`. Note that ATC `N06AX` is broad and includes drugs such as trazodone, mirtazapine, bupropion, venlafaxine/duloxetine, etc.
